prompt_en: Vertical intimate documentary photograph of one explicitly adult original character during a private late-night snack ritual at a small home kitchen window seat under one warm lamp. She has a severe straight bob, oval glasses, and a soft buttoned cardigan. Her baseline is meticulous composure and a private rule of arranging exactly three fruit slices on a chipped plate. Show her catching one slipping slice between two fingers during a precise three-piece fruit ritual, before it returns, while one pleased mouth corner escapes. Freeze the exact instant during the catch, before the third slice is returned: a chipped plate with two aligned fruit slices, one open crescent-shaped gap, and the caught third slice still above the rim. Her tracking gaze stays on the slice, but one pleased mouth corner has escaped before she can restore her severe expression. A fresh narrow juice fingerprint is forming where her fingers meet the chipped plate rim, recording the recovery already underway. The two aligned slices, open crescent gap, caught third slice, and fresh fingerprint all remain visible at once; the arrangement is not yet settled. Her clearly adult face, straight bob, oval glasses, and cardigan remain consistent. Her face, catching fingers, tilted slice, gap, and chipped plate share one tight focal plane. Warm lamp light and reflected fruit color bind her face, hand, and worn plate in the same light; 50mm medium-close perspective, foreground table-edge blur, natural skin texture, one loose hair, a creased cardigan, contact shadow, and gentle focus falloff. The close distance feels privately observed rather than displayed. Nonsexual private humor, no posed glamour.
